gizmo.title: Egwuregwu njem echiche
gizmo.description: Ụwa mepere emepe ị ga-ejegharị. Echiche na-achọta gị ma jụọ ajụjụ. Zaa nke ọma ka ị merie otu ma meghee ụlọ ya. Nchịkọta na-egosi mbọ na ihe ị ga-elele.

configure.title: Njem
configure.description: Ntụziaka e gosiri na ihuenyo mmalite. Gwa onye na-egwu ihe njem ahụ bụ maka ya.

configure.title: Echiche
configure.description: Echiche ọ bụla bụ ụlọ nwere anụ ọhịa.

configure.title: Aha etiti
configure.description: Echiche ahụ echiche niile na-agbakwunye na ya.

configure.title: Mgbe egwuregwu gasịrị
configure.description: Nhọrọ. Na-dochi igbe detuo-ntụziaka dị n'ọkpụkpụ ngwụcha site n'ọdịnaya nke gị, dịka nzọụkwụ na-esote ma ọ bụ njikọ.

configure.title: Bọtịnụ ndị ọzọ mgbe egwuregwu gasịrị
configure.description: Nhọrọ. Bọtịnụ ma ọ bụ njikọ e gosiri n'akụkụ Gbaa ọzọ na ọkpụkpụ ngwụcha.

advanced.title: Obi
advanced.description: Azịza ọjọọ tupu echiche ahụ agbapụ.

advanced.title: Mkpụrụ agbụrụ
advanced.description: Ederede ọ bụla. Otu mkpụrụ na-eme otu agbụrụ mgbe niile. Nke a bụ otu mkpụrụ ahụ HAX avatar na-eji.

advanced.title: Jiri agbụrụ onye banyere
advanced.description: Mgbe onye banyere na HAX, agbụrụ ahụ na-adị ka avatar nke ya. Mmadụ ndị ọzọ na-ahụ mkpụrụ dị n'elu.

advanced.title: Ahịrị dị n'elu ntụziaka
advanced.description: Hapụ ya n'efu maka ahịrị ndabara.

advanced.title: Ntụziaka ị ga-edepụta
advanced.description: E gosiri ya na ọkpụkpụ ngwụcha nwere bọtịnụ detuo. Hichapụ ya ka ị zoo igbe ahụ.

advanced.title: Aha egwuregwu
advanced.description: Na-enye egwuregwu a aha n'ihe omume ọganihu na ntụpọ OER Schema.

advanced.title: Id egwuregwu
advanced.description: Nhọrọ. Na-ekewa egwuregwu a n'ebe ndị ọzọ dị na peeji ahụ n'ihe omume ọganihu.
